commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a freed thief working for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. I rescued Sesk, who told me about the Unbound, a tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot that drains Hist sap, seals scars with grey paste called the seal, and sends jars to him for a draught tied to the Eye. Vosh-Leera sent me on to her handler. 2. Go to Nesh-Deeka at her house in Helstrom (door here) and speak to her. Cheeval-Xu can point the way. 3. Talk to Cheeval-Xu for directions, or go straight through the door to Nesh-Deeka House. The Boatmens Lodge door is another place to look. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is, or who Nesh-Deeka is. I can ask Nesh-Deeka and others.

answer 1. Nesh-Deeka is the handler. She says the Eye is the Eye of Argonia, the priest-kings jewel of Hist amber, lying at the Root under the sea behind a sealed gate. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it and means to kill whatever guards the Root. She wants proof of me. 2. Go to the Boatmens Lodge in Helstrom and get the jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, then bring it to Nesh-Deeka. 3. Lift it from his pack unseen, buy it for 100 gold (I have about 150), or fight Keel-Raa and his two hired men. The levy will not count a fight as a crime. 4. I do not understand what the Root really is, what guards it, or what the levy is exactly. I can ask Keel-Raa or Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. I killed Keel-Raa at the Boatmens Lodge and took his jar of stolen sap from his pack. I work for Vosh-Leera and Nesh-Deeka wants this as proof of me. 2. Take the jar to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom. 3. Bring it straight to her; I could also look around the lodge first, but nothing else is asked of me. 4. I still do not know what the Root guardian is, or what the seal is made of. I may learn more from Nesh-Deeka or from the sap itself.

answer 1. The quest is done. I killed Keel-Raa, took his sap jar and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. She made me Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, and gave me light armour and 200 gold. The order wants to find the Root before the Unbound and use the Eye to heal the trees. 2. Ride the rootworm from Helstrom city tree to Gideon, with Cheeval-Xu calling it, and look into the Eye of Argonia for sale in Gideons market. Most such eyes are glass, so I need to find where it came from. 3. Go to Gideon straight away, or first ask Nesh-Deeka about the Root, the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and the order. I can also trade with the order traders. 4. I do not understand the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or the order ranks. I can ask Nesh-Deeka about each of them.

answer I am Tarin, a freed thief. I am now Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, under Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. I killed Keel-Raa, an Unbound go-between, at the Boatmens Lodge, took his jar of sap and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. The levy did not count it a crime. I carry the Voh-Vastei armour (cuirass, boots, gauntlets, helm), about 350 gold, my lockpick, the Hist blessing and the Unbound note. The Eye of Argonia is the priest-kings jewel of Hist amber. It lies at the Root under the sea, behind a gate the last king sealed, and no living diver has found it. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it and means to kill whatever guards the Root. The order wants to find the Root first and use the Eye to heal the trees. Next step: ride the rootworm from Helstrom city tree to Gideon, with Cheeval-Xu calling it. There I should find the Eye of Argonia for sale in the market and learn where it came from, since most are glass. I have not yet asked Nesh-Deeka about the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, the order history or ranks. I still do not know what the seal is made of, what guards the Root, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is. Heem-Jasa teaches alchemy and sells goods. The order traders will now deal with me.
